title: REQ · A typed useUiStore hook and UiState types are exported for components
description: Context: components import state through a hook. Desired behavior: uiStore.ts exports useUiStore (a typed Zustand hook accepting selectors), plus the UiState and ModalId types. Expected result: a component can call useUiStore(s => s.drawerOpen) with type inference. Why: typed, selector-based access avoids unneeded re-renders.
acceptance_criteria: Given import { useUiStore } from the store module, when called with a selector s => s.soundEnabled, then it returns a boolean
Given the module, when its exports are inspected, then useUiStore is a function with getState and setState
Given tsc --noEmit, when run, then the store compiles without type errors
definition_of_done: Exports are typed and the type-check passes
